text.description_html:
Bommer 7313-1.250-626, Brass Spring Door Pivot Hinge Box Clamp Mounted

Bommer Industries has been in business since 1876, with over 125 years of quality products. Their products are American made with American Metals.

Bommer 7313 Spring Door Pivot Hinge, Box Clamp Mounted on Door and Door Jamb. Cast Brass construction pivot hinge for doors up to 36 Inches Wide, 1-1/4 Inches Thick with a Maximum Door Weight of 75 lbs.

Specifications of the Spring Pivot:

  • Maximum Door Width: 36"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: 1-1/8"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 75 lbs.
  • Cast Brass Construction
  • Box Clamp Mounted Pivot
  • Double Acting
  • Maximum Swing: 130º each direction
  • Ball Bearing Pivot
  • Non-Handed
  • Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Finish: Brushed Chrome
  • Box Clamp Door Bracket: For doors 1-1/4" Thick
  • Box Clamp Jamb Bracket: For Jamb 1-1/4" Thick
  • Packaged with #12 - 1-1/4", #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws plus Thru-Bolts for Box Clamp Brackets
  • Bommer 7313 Dimensions (PDF)
  • How to Reactivate Tension on Bommer Spring Pivots

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting screw hardware. Enough to do one door.
